events.name: Miami Hurricanes at North Carolina Tar Heels

headlines.description: — Miami kept finishing drives in the end zone, much as it had all season in riding a high-scoring attack to an unbeaten record and a No. 1 ranking.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fletcher's go-ahead score, Lightfoot's defensive play help No. 1 Miami rally past UNC 38-35

events.name: Ohio State Buckeyes at USC Trojans

headlines.description: — When Trent Mosley took a screen pass straight through the heart of Ohio State's defense for an exhilarating touchdown on the second snap, Southern California realized something special might be brewing on Halloween night.
headlines.shortLinkText: USC stuns No. 2 Ohio State 30-18 with big plays from Jayden Maiava, freshman Trent Mosley

events.name: Florida Gators at Georgia Bulldogs

headlines.description: — Chris Cole returned a fumble recovery 66 yards for a touchdown and No. 3 Georgia took advantage of four turnovers by No. 17 Florida to beat the Gators 27-8 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 3 Georgia takes advantage of 4 turnovers by No. 17 Florida to beat Gators 27-8

events.name: Minnesota Golden Gophers at Indiana Hoosiers

headlines.description: — Indiana coach Curt Cignetti always believed in backup quarterback Grant Wilson.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 4 Indiana forces overtime with a 60-yard FG then beats Minnesota 23-16

events.name: Notre Dame Fighting Irish at Navy Midshipmen

headlines.description: — CJ Carr passed for 210 yards and two touchdowns, and Nolan James Jr. added
headlines.shortLinkText: Carr passes for 2 TDs, James adds pair of rushing scores in No. 5 Notre Dame's 35-13 win over Navy

events.name: Utah Utes at Cincinnati Bearcats

headlines.description: — Devon Dampier threw for 260 yards and two touchdowns and No. 6 Utah extended the nation’s longest active winning streak with a 49-25 victory over Cincinnati on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 6 Utah improves to 8-0 with 49-25 win over Cincinnati

events.name: Nevada Wolf Pack at UCLA Bruins

headlines.description: — Another week, another win for unbeaten and seventh-ranked UCLA.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 7 UCLA storms to 8-0 as 3 first-quarter picks fuel a 27-0 Rose Bowl shutout of Nevada

events.name: Arizona State Sun Devils at BYU Cougars

headlines.description: — Bear Bachmeier threw for 236 yards and a touchdown to lead No. 8 BYU to a 27-20 victory over Arizona State on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bear Bachmeier throws for 236 yards and a touchdown as No. 8 BYU holds off Arizona State 27-20

events.name: Mississippi State Bulldogs at Texas Longhorns

headlines.description: — Arch Manning passed for three touchdowns, Maraad Watson returned a fumble 61 yards for a score just before halftime and
headlines.shortLinkText: Dominant defense and Manning's 3 TD passes send No. 11 Texas past Mississippi State 31-3

events.name: Auburn Tigers at Ole Miss Rebels

headlines.description: — Trinidad Chambliss threw for 263 yards and two touchdowns and ran for another and No. 12 Mississippi pulled away for a 45-15 win over Auburn on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 12 Mississippi rolls to 45-15 victory over Auburn

events.name: Arizona Wildcats at Texas Tech Red Raiders

headlines.description: — Tommy Castellanos threw two touchdown passes and ran for 117 yards and a score as the starter over Will Hammond, and No. 13 Texas...
headlines.shortLinkText: Tommy Castellanos gets the start and helps No. 13 Texas Tech to 34-26 win over No. 22 Arizona

events.name: Virginia Cavaliers at Wake Forest Demon Deacons

headlines.description: — In the middle of last week, Wake Forest head coach Jake Dickert wasn’t too thrilled with how his football team was preparing for Virginia.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 14 Wake Forest stretches its winning streak to five games with a 51-7 rout of Virginia

events.name: SMU Mustangs at Syracuse Orange

headlines.description: — Steve Angeli hit little-used tight end Noah Meyers on a 2-yard scoring strike with 17 seconds to go and Syracuse defeated No. 19 SMU 30-27 Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Syracuse scores game-winning touchdown with 17 seconds to go to defeat No. 19 SMU 30-27

events.name: Northwestern Wildcats at Oregon Ducks

headlines.description: — Dylan Raiola completed 22 of 31 passes for 336 yards and three touchdowns to help Oregon rally to beat No. 20 Northwestern 34-26 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiola throws for 3 TDs to help Oregon beat No. 20 Northwestern 34-26

events.name: Texas State Bobcats at Boise State Broncos

headlines.description: — Max Cutforth threw three touchdown passes in the final seven minutes in relief of injured starter Maddux Madsen, and No. 20 Boise State rallied to beat Texas State 46-45 on Saturday night after blowing a 25-point halftime lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: No. 20 Boise State rallies to beat Texas State 46-45 after blowing a 25-point halftime lead

events.name: Missouri Tigers at Arkansas Razorbacks

headlines.description: — Austin Simmons threw for 179 yards and two touchdowns, and Jamal Roberts had 158 total yards and two touchdowns as No. 23 Missouri topped Arkansas 34-10 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Austin Simmons leads No. 23 Missouri to 34-10 win over Arkansas

events.name: Oklahoma State Cowboys at Iowa State Cyclones

headlines.description: — Kyle Konrardy made a 34-yard field goal as time expired to give Iowa State a 51-49 victory over No. 24 Oklahoma State on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Konrardy hits field goal as time expires to lift Iowa State past No. 24 Oklahoma State, 51-49

events.name: Wisconsin Badgers at Iowa Hawkeyes

headlines.description: — Hank Brown threw for 222 yards and two touchdowns, and Iowa’s defense shut out No. 25 Wisconsin for the second consecutive year in a 30-0 win Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hank Brown throws for 222 yards and two touchdowns as Iowa shuts out No. 25 Wisconsin 30-0

events.name: California Golden Bears at NC State Wolfpack

headlines.description: — N.C. State was ready for something positive after a week of negativity following a disappointing loss at Stanford and the firing of coach Dave Doeren.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bailey, Gause lead NC State to 31-10 win over California

events.name: Boston College Eagles at Duke Blue Devils

headlines.description: — Nate Sheppard ran for three of his school-record five touchdowns in the first half as Duke rolled past Boston College 47-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sheppard runs for five touchdowns and Duke races past Boston College 47-2

events.name: Illinois Fighting Illini at Maryland Terrapins

headlines.description: — Ethan Moczulski kicked a 26-yard field goal on the final play to lift Illinois to a 20-17 victory over Maryland on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Illinois struggles but beats Maryland 20-17 on a 26-yard field goal by Ethan Moczulski

events.name: UAB Blazers at South Florida Bulls

headlines.description: — Asani Redwood and Grayson Howard returned fumbles for touchdowns and CJ Hicks had four sacks, leading South Florida to a 30-10 victory over UAB on Saturday, making the Bulls bowl-eligible for the fourth consecutive season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Two fumble returns for touchdowns highlight South Florida's 30-10 win over UAB

events.name: Bowling Green Falcons at Western Michigan Broncos

headlines.description: — Cole Cabana raced 82 yards for a touchdown, Dieter Kelly kicked three second-half field goals and Western Michigan defeated Bowling Green 23-10 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cabana's long TD run, Kelly's 3 FGs help Western Michigan beat Bowling Green 23-10

events.name: Michigan Wolverines at Rutgers Scarlet Knights

headlines.description: — Michigan’s season-long offensive woes finally eased Saturday as freshman quarterback Tommy Carr led the Wolverines to 427 yards of offense in a 28-21 win over Rutgers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tommy Carr runs for two TDs, passes for one in Michigan's 28-21 win over Rutgers

events.name: Marshall Thundering Herd at Old Dominion Monarchs

headlines.description: — TJ Lester ran for two touchdowns, Jorge Diaz Nicholas made a school-record five field goals and Marshall turned four turnovers into 20 points en route to a 36-23 win over Old Dominion on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lester scores twice, Diaz Nicholas kicks 5 FGs, Marshall controls Old Dominion 36-23

events.name: Kansas State Wildcats at Colorado Buffaloes

headlines.description: — Tight end Charlie Williams' only catch Saturday came on an 11-yard touchdown throw from Isaac Wilson in overtime, powering Colorado past Kansas State 27-24.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colorado beats Kansas State 27-24 in OT on Wilson's TD pass to Charlie Williams

events.name: Coastal Carolina Chanticleers at Georgia State Panthers

headlines.description: — Deuce Bailey threw for 297 yards and three touchdowns as Coastal Carolina scored 31 points over the middle two quarters of a 31-20 victory over Georgia State on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deuce Bailey's 3 touchdown passes power Coastal Carolina in 31-20 win over Georgia State

events.name: UConn Huskies at Air Force Falcons

headlines.description: — Kemper Hodges rushed for 200 yards and four touchdowns as Air Force, once again, leaned on its ground game to hold off UConn 35-26 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kemper Hodges' 4 TDs lead Air Force ground attack in 35-26 win over UConn

events.name: Temple Owls at East Carolina Pirates

headlines.description: — TJ Engleman Jr. ran for 107 yards including a second-half touchdown that helped East Carolina defeat Temple 17-9 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Engleman runs for 107 yards and a TD in East Carolina's 17-9 win over Temple

events.name: Louisiana Tech Bulldogs at South Alabama Jaguars

headlines.description: — Blake Baker threw three touchdown passes and Louisiana Tech shut out South Alabama in the second half for a 35-20 victory on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Baker throws 3 TD passes to lead Louisiana Tech over South Alabama 35-20

events.name: Stanford Cardinal at Louisville Cardinals

headlines.description: — Lincoln Kienholz threw for 250 yards, two touchdowns and rushed for another score to lead Louisville to a 52-24 win over Stanford on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lincoln Kienholz has 3 total touchdowns to lead Louisville past Stanford 52-24

events.name: Kansas Jayhawks at TCU Horned Frogs

headlines.description: — Max Carroll returned an interception 60 yards for a touchdown, quarterback Jaden Craig ran 17 yards for the go-ahead score with 1:09 remaining and TCU beat Kansas 22-16 on Saturday.

events.name: Colorado State Rams at Utah State Aggies

events.name: UTEP Miners at North Dakota State Bison

headlines.description: — Nathan Hayes accounted for two touchdowns and the North Dakota State defense had another shutdown performance in a 31-7 victory over UTEP on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nathan Hayes accounts for 2 TDs, defense does the rest in North Dakota State's 31-7 win over UTEP

events.name: Florida International Panthers at Liberty Flames

headlines.description: — Deshawn Purdie threw for 227 yards and a touchdown, and Kam Davis ran for two scores as Liberty overwhelmed Florida International 49-10 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deshawn Purdie, Kam Davis lead Liberty in overwhelming 49-10 rout of FIU

events.name: Southern Miss Golden Eagles at UL Monroe Warhawks

headlines.description: — Steven Robinson and Jamarice Wilder each ran for more than 100 yards and combined for three touchdowns to lead Southern Miss to a 35-21 victory over Louisiana-Monroe on Saturday.

events.name: New Mexico Lobos at San José State Spartans

headlines.description: — Scottre Humphrey rushed for two touchdowns and New Mexico beat San Jose State 21-16 on Saturday to win its fifth straight game and remain unbeaten in Mountain West Conference games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Humphrey scores 2 TDs and New Mexico beats San Jose State to remain unbeaten in Mountain West games

events.name: South Carolina Gamecocks at Oklahoma Sooners

headlines.description: — LaNorris Sellers passed for 301 yards and three touchdowns, and South Carolina's defense limited Oklahoma to 118 yards and 10 points through three quarters of a 42-25 win on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: LaNorris Sellers leads South Carolina past Oklahoma 42-25 for a third straight win

events.name: Purdue Boilermakers at Penn State Nittany Lions

headlines.description: — Cam Wallace never doubted he’d be able to return from a grisly injury that could’ve cost him his career.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wallace's big rushing day leads Penn State over Purdue 31-17, 1st Big Ten win under Matt Campbell

events.name: App State Mountaineers at Georgia Southern Eagles

headlines.description: — Taeo Todd had a rushing touchdown, Tripp Bryant kicked four field goals, and Georgia Southern beat Appalachian State 19-3 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryant's 4 FGs, Todd's rushing TD help Georgia Southern beat Appalachian State 19-3

events.name: Clemson Tigers at Florida State Seminoles

headlines.description: — Tait Reynolds threw a pair of touchdown passes, his first in more than a month, as Clemson jumped out early and held off a late rally, defeating Florida State 36-24 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tait Reynolds scores 3 touchdowns in Clemson's 36-24 win over Florida State

events.name: Washington State Cougars at San Diego State Aztecs

headlines.description: — Javion Kinnard had 87 yards rushing and two touchdowns, wide receiver Bert Emanuel Jr. threw a 2-yard touchdown pass to Jackson Ford, and San Diego State beat Washington State 26-20 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Javion Kinnard's 2 rushing TDs help San Diego State beat Washington State 26-20

events.name: Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets at Pittsburgh Panthers

headlines.description: — Freshman running back Damon Ferguson ran for a season-high 185 yards and a touchdown and Pittsburgh breezed past Georgia Tech 34-11 on Saturday night to snap a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Damon Ferguson Jr. runs for a season-high 185 yards and 2 TDs as Pitt drills Georgia Tech 34-11

events.name: Washington Huskies at Nebraska Cornhuskers

headlines.description: — Chris Lawson scored the go-ahead touchdown on a 25-yard catch-and-run with 1:30 left and Alex McLaughlin returned Anthony Colandrea's third interception of the game 48 yards for the clinching score as Washington came from behind to beat Nebraska...

events.name: Army Black Knights at Memphis Tigers

headlines.description: — Marcus Stokes threw four touchdown passes and ran for another score to lead Memphis over Army 49-22 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stokes accounts for 5 TDs, leads Memphis over Army 49-22

events.name: Northern Illinois Huskies at UNLV Rebels

headlines.description: — Jackson Arnold threw three touchdown passes, Jai’Den Thomas had 114 yards rushing and a touchdown on 16 carries, and UNLV beat Northern Illinois 31-24 on Saturday night, the Huskies 10th consecutive loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson Arnold throws 3 TD passes, UNLV hands Northern Illinois its 10th straight loss, 31-24

events.name: Oregon State Beavers at Fresno State Bulldogs

headlines.description: — Jayden Mandal threw two touchdown passes to Josiah Freeman and added two rushing TDs, Bryson Donelson had 108 yards rushing and a score, and Fresno State snapped Oregon State's five-game win streak with a 38-22 win over the Beavers on Saturday night.
